[EN] It's unlikely there are any other survivors, but please keep an eye out while you're in the mines.

I can't go back. I just...I can't. But I'd never forgive myself if no one even looked for signs of life.

My poor brother. He was so young.... It should have been me.
[ES] Es poco probable que haya otros sobrevivientes, pero por favor vigila bien mientras estés en las minas.

No puedo volver. Simplemente... no puedo. Pero nunca me perdonaría si nadie siquiera buscara señales de vida.

Mi pobre hermano. Era tan joven... Debí haber sido yo.

[EN] (A pendant hangs from the neck of this mangled corpse. "Pattek" is inscribed on the back. You put it in your pocket.)
[ES] (Un colgante cuelga del cuello de este cadáver mutilado. "Pattek" está grabado en la parte posterior. Lo guardas en tu bolsillo.)

[EN] They're all dead? It's just as I feared.

They were alive only a few hours ago....

Oh, this pendant. I know this pendant. It belonged to Pattek.

Here, I'll...I'll see to it personally that his family gets it.
[ES] ¿Están todos muertos? Es justo como temía.

Estaban vivos hace apenas unas horas...

Oh, este colgante. Conozco este colgante. Le pertenecía a Pattek.

Toma, me... me aseguraré personalmente de que su familia lo reciba.
